verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet offers a customizable Trust Center that users set up and publish. Nothing shows that subprocessor lists, document renewals or control status sync into it automatically from the platform. Having a trust center is adjacent to the story, not proof of self-updating content.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
